goal: In Fee Management, look up the account and waive the assessed overdraft fee, reaching the reversal confirmation.
reason: security interception: manager override PIN required
detail: posts the reversal to the host — cannot be undone
observation_digest:
URL: app://FirstCore.Desktop
== frame SecurityOverlayPane "SecurityOverlayPane"
  msg [lblHeader_SECURITY] SECURITY INTERCEPTION: Manager Override PIN Required
  msg [lblSecurityNotice] Account ▮▮REDACTED▮▮ carries a supervisory restriction. A manager
override PIN is required to continue this transaction.
  msg [lblPinPrompt] Override PIN:
  field <edit> id=txtOverridePin name=Override PIN value="Access denied"
  control <button> id=btnAuthorize text="Authorize"
== frame NavigationPane "NavigationPane"
  msg [lblHeader_Application] Application Menu
  control <button> id=btnBalanceInquiry text="Balance Inquiry"
  control <button> id=btnTransactionHistory text="Transaction History"
  control <button> id=btnFeeManagement text="Fee Management"
  control <button> id=btnAddressMaintenance text="Address Maintenance"
== frame WorkspacePane>FeeModulePane "FeeModulePane"
  msg [lblHeader_Fee] Fee Management — Account Inquiry
  msg [lblAcctPrompt] Account Identifier:
  msg [lblAccountDetail] ACCT ▮▮REDACTED▮▮   NAME RESTRICTED PARTY   BR 001   PRODUCT REG CHECKING   STATUS ACTIVE   LEDGER BAL 9,430.11
  msg [lblFeeRow] FEE REF FEE-▮▮REDACTED▮▮   OVERDRAFT ITEM FEE   POSTED 08/26/2026   AMT 35.00
  field <edit> id=txtAccountId name=Account Identifier value="▮▮REDACTED▮▮"
  control <button> id=btnExecuteInquiry text="Execute Inquiry"
  control <button> id=btnWaiveFee text="Waive Fee"
== frame WorkspacePane "WorkspacePane"
  msg [lblHeader_Workspace] Workspace
  msg [lblNoModule] Select a function from the application menu.
== frame (top) "FirstCore Banking Platform"
resume_plan: on handback the run resumes at step checkpoint
